title: Terms of Rescheduling for Marlowe & Finch Home Delivery, by Service Level
content:
A Marlowe & Finch Home Delivery booking may be moved by the customer to another date or window. The terms below set, for each service level, the notice that makes a reschedule free, the fee for one made inside that notice, the number of customer reschedules allowed per booking, the treatment of reschedules forced by severe weather, and the channels through which a reschedule can be made.

## Schedule of reschedule terms

| Service level | Free if made at least this many hours before the start of the scheduled window | Fee for a reschedule inside the free notice period | Customer reschedules allowed per booking | Reschedules forced by severe weather are free and not counted | Channels |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Curbside Delivery | 48 | $25.00 | 2 | Yes | Online, app, phone agent |
| Threshold Delivery | 48 | $25.00 | 2 | Yes | Online, app, phone agent |
| Room of Choice Delivery | 48 | $35.00 | 2 | Yes | Online, app, phone agent |
| White Glove Delivery | 48 | $35.00 | 3 | Yes | Online, app, phone agent |
| White Glove Delivery with Assembly | 48 | $35.00 | 3 | Yes | Online, app, phone agent |
| Premier White Glove with Haul-Away | 48 | $0.00 | 3 | Yes | Online, app, phone agent |

## Notes to the schedule

1. The notice period is measured in hours before the start of the scheduled arrival window, not before the scheduled date as a whole.
2. The reschedule fee is in US dollars to the cent. At Premier White Glove with Haul-Away it is $0.00.
3. The number of reschedules allowed counts the customer's reschedules on one booking.
4. At every level, a reschedule forced by severe weather is free and does not count toward that number.
5. The three channels, online, the Marlowe & Finch app and a phone agent, are open at every level.

## Illustrations (hypothetical timings, scheduled window starting at 8:00 on the delivery date)

| When the reschedule is made | Hours before window start | Position under the 48-hour notice |
|---|---|---|
| 8:00 two days before | 48 | At least 48 hours: free |
| 7:00 two days before | 49 | Free |
| 9:00 two days before | 47 | Inside the notice period: the level's reschedule fee |
